changelog: Adds Jellyfin 12.2 compatibility and profile-aware trailer matching. The anchor genre remains mandatory, candidates with incompatible tone or mostly unrelated genres are rejected, and the closest remaining genre profiles are ranked first.
description: Maintains separate recent and upcoming regular-movie and anime-movie trailer pools and plays same-genre trailers before movies.
name: Trailer Reel
overview: Recent and upcoming same-genre regular and anime movie trailers as Jellyfin prerolls.
